entities.name: PMID:25085021
observations: 2014 Respiratory Research study: aerosolized LPS was administered to mice; lung tissue and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) were analyzed.
BALF IL-1β and IL-18 depended on IPAF, and to a lesser extent ASC; IL-1α did not.

Caspase-1/11 transcript increased, but increased lung activity and a role in IL-1 cytokine production were not detected; later caspase-8 activity had no detected role in cytokine production in this model.

entities.name: IPAF / NLRC4
observations: In the mouse aerosolized-LPS lung study, BALF IL-1β and IL-18 levels were IPAF-dependent.

entities.name: IL-1β
observations: Inhaled aerosolized LPS increased BALF IL-1β in mice; the response was reported to depend on IPAF, while caspase-1/11/8 roles were not detected in that model.

entities.name: LPS lung IL-1β/IPAF
observations: In mice challenged with aerosolized LPS, BALF IL-1β was IPAF-dependent; caspase-1/11 activity or contribution and caspase-8 contribution were not detected in the reported lung model.
